node_definition.done_when: A new tests/test_dead_wait_blocks_only_its_request.py shows five arms. (1) With a live queued request in project A waiting on a run: ref that neither exists nor is in the ledger, a dispatch in project B of a plan section that declares no waits of its own succeeds, and the arm asserts the dispatch reached _validated_batch_waits through its own section's readiness verdict. (2) A dispatch whose own batch names that missing ref is still refused with 'wait names missing request'. (3) A cycle through existing requests is still refused. (4) A blocked-upstream request's write paths do not refuse another node's dispatch on the same path, while a launched run's do (WAITING_REQUEST_PHASES in reckon/crew/node.py gains blocked-upstream). (5) While a launch attempt for a queued request is refused on a peer's scope claim, the request's pointer is present in live/ throughout the attempt, read from inside a stubbed dispatch, and a dispatch --after it succeeds in that window; _launch_queued no longer unlinks the pointer, and dispatch() excludes the request's own run id from both its scope check and its existing_node_run dedup (reckon/crew/dispatch.py around :1694 and :1814), so the launch proceeds rather than re-queuing itself. In _validated_batch_waits an existing request's unresolvable ref becomes a leaf in the cycle graph instead of raising. The test files importing each changed module add no failures against the base revision; ruff check and ruff format --check pass on the changed paths. The coordinator runs the full importer arms, so do not attempt them.
